Generalist (no sector focus). Aggregators (PitchBook) list 2023-2024 deals (Seerlinq, Cequence, BiteBerry) but no primary source with a quote was found, so only 2020 deals are recorded; typical ticket EUR 100-800k, max EUR 1.6m. No AUM figure found.
